question: Which of the following is a heart - related disease?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Angina**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Angina** is a condition marked by severe pain in the chest, often spreading to the shoulders, arms, and neck, caused by an inadequate blood supply to the heart.
 
• It is a symptom of an underlying heart problem, usually coronary heart disease (CHD).
 
• Angina occurs when the heart muscle doesn't get as much blood as it needs, often because one or more of the heart's arteries is narrowed or blocked.
 
• There are different types of angina, including stable angina, unstable angina, and variant angina, each with distinct characteristics and treatment approaches.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Goiter** refers to the abnormal enlargement of the thyroid gland.
 
• **Diabetes** is a disease that occurs when your blood glucose, also called blood sugar, is too high.
 
• **Acromegaly** is a hormonal disorder that develops when the pituitary gland produces too much growth hormone.
 
• While these conditions are serious and require medical attention, they are not directly related to heart diseases like angina.
